what: Explainer kit WGSL (web/explainer/wgsl.mjs) against its float64 reference (web/explainer/ref.mjs)

lod_hash.metric: mismatched keep decisions and hash_unit values over 65,536 ids x 5 keep fractions
lod_hash.why: integer hash, top 24 bits to float: exact in f32 and f64

bezier.metric: max abs error of the curve point, scene units, control points within 0..2000
bezier.why: f32 epsilon 1.2e-7 x coordinates up to 2000 x about 8 terms

pulse.metric: max abs error of the pulse brightness

orb.metric: max abs error per channel, linear radiance (values up to about 3.5), over a 256 x 64 polar grid r in 0..2, three specs (plain, 7-blade iris with a ring, wide halo)
orb.why: f32 atan2, exp and smoothstep; the iris edge has kinks at blade corners but no jumps

atmosphere.metric: max abs error per channel over a 128 x 72 grid at t = 0 and t = 37.5, two specs
atmosphere.why: value noise is C2 across lattice cells, so an f32 floor that lands on the other side of an integer still gives a nearby value

points_placement.metric: max distance between the drawn centroid of each of 64 isolated points (radius 6 scene units, 1.6 px) and its CPU projection, px, at 512 x 288; bias_max (added 2026-10-16, after run 1) bounds the mean offset in x and in y

points_lod_1m.metric: a 1,048,576-point cloud draws with LOD; the drawn count equals the reference count of ids with hash_unit(id) < keep

controls.orb_core_radius_3pct: the kernel with the core radius scaled by 1.03 must exceed the orb bound
controls.hash_constant_changed: the kernel with one hash multiplier changed must show LOD mismatches
controls.points_shifted_1px: the reference positions shifted by 1 px must exceed the placement bound

amendments.what: Run 1 (evidence/explainer-parity-run1-failed.json) failed four checks. Three were in the harness and the shader, one in the measurement.
findings: orb specs 0 and 2 (max 0.58 and 0.81): the reference and the packer used different default irises (ref.mjs defaulted to 7 blades, pack.mjs to none). Fixed by one ORB default in ref.mjs that pack.mjs re-exports. The bound is unchanged.

orb spec 1 (max 0.0051, p99 0.0017): WGSL lets cos be off by 2^-11 absolute, which moved the 7-blade iris edge and its thin ring. Fixed in the shader with a Taylor cos on |x| <= pi/3. The bound is unchanged; run 2 measured max 4.5e-6.

points placement (max 0.372 px against 0.35): one point was off, point 0. The layer's 'no selection' value -1 was converted to u32 in the shader, which gives 0, so point 0 was drawn as the selected point (larger, brighter). Fixed in the shader (a negative value now means no selection). A first guess, that 1.6 px blobs cannot be located precisely in 8-bit pixels, was wrong: a run with 3.2 px blobs still failed on point 0 alone (max 0.527 px, every other point within 0.036 px). The measurement is back to 1.6 px blobs. The 0.35 px bound is unchanged; a bias bound of 0.05 px was added.
